finding: >3-day-late orders score 2.44 points below on-time orders (1.86 vs 4.29); the association survives adjustment at -0.072 points per day late
so_what: 8.1% of delivered orders arrive late; the worst bucket drives most 1–2 star reviews
action: start with the seller states at the top of late_by_seller_state.csv: set delivery-promise buffers and carrier SLAs there first
expected_effect: up to ~0.12 points on the average review score if >3-day lates reviewed like on-time orders - an upper bound, association only
confidence: medium: large sample and the association survives controls, but no experiment and unmeasured confounders (e.g. carrier, distance) remain
